# Canvas Escape

- Player controls a small square that moves forward automatically.
- Click/tap to make the square jump over gaps and obstacles.
- The canvas continuously scrolls; speed gradually increases.
- **Lose condition:** Colliding with an obstacle or falling into a gap ends the game.

1: // Minimal Canvas Escape game
2: 
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const resize = () => {
8:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
9:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
10:     groundY = canvas.height - 50;
11:   };
12:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
13:   resize();
14: 
15:   // audio context for sound effects
16:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
17:   const playJump = () => {
18:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
19:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
20:     osc.frequency.value = 400;
21:     osc.type = 'square';
22:     osc.connect(gain);
23:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
24:     osc.start();
25:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
26:   };
27:   const playCrash = () => {
28:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
29:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
30:     osc.frequency.value = 150;
31:     osc.type = 'sawtooth';
32:     osc.connect(gain);
33:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
34:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, audioCtx.currentTime);
35:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
36:     osc.start();
37:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
38:   };
39: 
40:   const player = {
41:     x: 100,
42:     y: 0,
43:     w: 30,
44:     h: 30,
45:     vy: 0,
46:     jumpStrength: -12,
47:     color: '#ff0',
48:     onGround: false,
49:     update() {
50:       this.vy += 0.6; // gravity
51:       this.y += this.vy;
52:       if (this.y + this.h >= groundY) {
53:         this.y = groundY - this.h;
54:         this.vy = 0;
55:         this.onGround = true;
56:       } else {
57:         this.onGround = false;
58:       }
59:     },
60:     jump() {
61:       if (this.onGround) {
62:         this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
63:         playJump();
64:       }
65:     },
66:     draw() {
67:       // draw player as a rounded square with gradient
68:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x, this.y, this.x, this.y + this.h);
69:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff0');
70:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ffa500');
71:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
72:       const radius = 6;
73:       ctx.beginPath();
74:       ctx.moveTo(this.x + radius, this.y);
75:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w - radius, this.y);
76:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y, this.x + this.w, this.y + radius);
77:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h - radius);
78:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h, this.x + this.w - radius, this.y + this.h);
79:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + radius, this.y + this.h);
80:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h, this.x, this.y + this.h - radius);
81:       ctx.lineTo(this.x, this.y + radius);
82:       ctx.quadraticCurveTo(this.x, this.y, this.x + radius, this.y);
83:       ctx.closePath();
84:       ctx.fill();
85:     },
86:   };
87: 
88:   let groundY = canvas.height - 50;
89:   const speed = 4; // scroll speed
90:   const obstacles = [];
91:   let scroll = 0;
92:   let nextObstacleX = canvas.width;
93:   let gameOver = false;
94: 
95:   const randomBetween = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
96: 
97:   const addObstacle = () => {
98:     const gap = Math.random() < 0.5; // 50% gap, else block
99:     const width = randomBetween(30, 80);
100:     if (gap) {
101:       obstacles.push({ x: nextObstacleX, w: width, type: 'gap' });
102:     } else {
103:       const height = randomBetween(30, 80);
104:       obstacles.push({ x: nextObstacleX, w: width, h: height, type: 'block' });
105:     }
106:     nextObstacleX += width + randomBetween(100, 200);
107:   };
108: 
109:   // initial obstacles
110:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) addObstacle();
111: 
112:   const handleJump = () => player.jump();
113:   window.addEventListener('click', handleJump);
114:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space') handleJump(); });
115: 
116:   const checkCollision = () => {
117:     for (const o of obstacles) {
118:       if (o.type === 'block') {
119:         const ox = o.x - scroll;
120:         if (
121:           player.x < ox + o.w &&
122:           player.x + player.w > ox &&
123:           player.y + player.h > groundY - o.h
124:         ) {
125:           return true;
126:         }
127:       }
128:     }
129:     // falling into gap
130:     const overGap = obstacles.some(o => {
131:       if (o.type !== 'gap') return false;
132:       const ox = o.x - scroll;
133:       return player.x + player.w > ox && player.x < ox + o.w && player.y + player.h >= groundY;
134:     });
135:     return overGap && !player.onGround;
136:   };
137: 
138:   const loop = () => {
139:     if (gameOver) {
140:       // overlay dim background
141:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
142:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
143:       // draw Game Over text with shadow
144:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff4444';
145:       ctx.font = '64px sans-serif';
146:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
147:       ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
148:       ctx.shadowOffsetX = 2;
149:       ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
150:       ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
151:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
152:       // reset shadow for future frames
153:       ctx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
154:       return;
155:     }
156:     // draw sky background gradient
157:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
158:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB');
159:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#B0E0E6');
160:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
161:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
162: 
163:     // draw ground with gradient
164:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, canvas.height);
165:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#8B5A2B');
166:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#654321');
167:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
168:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, canvas.width, canvas.height - groundY);
169: 
170:     // update and draw obstacles with rounded gradient blocks
171:     scroll += speed;
172:     for (const o of obstacles) {
173:       const ox = o.x - scroll;
174:       if (o.type === 'block') {
175:         const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ox, groundY - o.h, ox, groundY);
176:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#b22222');
177:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#8b0000');
178:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
179:         const radius = 4;
180:         ctx.beginPath();
181:         ctx.moveTo(ox + radius, groundY - o.h);
182:         ctx.lineTo(ox + o.w - radius, groundY - o.h);
183:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox + o.w, groundY - o.h, ox + o.w, groundY - o.h + radius);
184:         ctx.lineTo(ox + o.w, groundY - radius);
185:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox + o.w, groundY, ox + o.w - radius, groundY);
186:         ctx.lineTo(ox + radius, groundY);
187:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox, groundY, ox, groundY - radius);
188:         ctx.lineTo(ox, groundY - o.h + radius);
189:         ctx.quadraticCurveTo(ox, groundY - o.h, ox + radius, groundY - o.h);
190:         ctx.closePath();
191:         ctx.fill();
192:       } else {
193:         // gap: do nothing (ground missing)
194:       }
195:     }
196:     // remove passed obstacles
197:     while (obstacles.length && obstacles[0].x - scroll < -obstacles[0].w) obstacles.shift();
198:     // ensure enough ahead
199:     while (nextObstacleX - scroll < canvas.width * 2) addObstacle();
200: 
201:     player.update();
202:     player.draw();
203: 
204:     if (checkCollision()) gameOver = true;
205: 
206:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
207:   };
208:   loop();
209: })();

(End of file - total 209 lines)
</content>
